title: Roadside
description: Elm Avenue's lawns beyond the sidewalks with OutRun-style roadside billboards (houses behind picket fences and hedges, mailboxes, trees, lamp posts, a gnome, a bike, a washing line) that scale with depth and scroll with the road, beside today's bare verge, with the 18 new sprites and their sizes.

title: Start screen shop
description: The start screen with help, sound and settings top right, the Pocket strip (every gear item as a tile, one brought per walk) in place of the Gear section, and a Pet shop building in the gate scene for gear, dogs and slots, with the shop page, the strip's geometry and the locked tile states.
